title: The impact of CAATs on financial auditor task effectiveness, moderated by computer literacy
core_idea: Investigate how Technology Acceptance Model factors (perceived ease of use, perceived usefulness) drive CAATs adoption among Indonesian external auditors, examine whether computer literacy moderates those relationships, and assess the connection between CAATs usage and financial audit task effectiveness.
tldr: Empirical TAM-based study using questionnaires and SEM-PLS with 110 Indonesian external auditors to evaluate determinants of CAATs adoption, the moderating role of computer literacy, and implications for financial audit task effectiveness.
